simple.meaning: מַבּוּעַ (mabbûwaʻ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a fountain.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַבּוּעַ (H4002) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ecclesiastes 12:6, with occurrences in Ecclesiastes, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַבּוּעַ (H4002) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַבּוּעַ (H4002) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַבּוּעַ (mabbûwaʻ) / H4002 is traced through Ecclesiastes 12:6, Isaiah 35:7, Isaiah 49:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
